title: The Return
hook: Shams came back to Konya. Then he vanished, and no one ever found him.

segments.fa: بروید ای حریفان بکشید یار ما را
segments.en: Go, my friends. Bring my beloved back.

segments.fa: به من آورید آخر صنم گریزپا را
segments.en: Bring me, at last, the idol who keeps running away.

segments.fa: به ترانه‌های شیرین به بهانه‌های زرین
segments.en: With sweet songs, with golden excuses,

tafsir: Rumi sent his son, Sultan Walad, to Damascus to bring Shams home.
Sultan Walad later wrote that he walked on foot beside Shams's horse.
Many readers hear this ghazal as that call. We cannot be sure.
Konya celebrated. But the old jealousy soon came back.
Then, one day, Shams was gone. This time, for good.
Later legends say he was killed. Historians are not sure.

outro.say: Part seven. Rumi goes looking for him in Damascus. What does he find? Follow The Guest House.
outro.title: Part 7 · Rumi searches, and finds Shams within
